decisions.decision: ATTACH READ_ONLY does NOT bypass the DuckDB writer lock
decisions.rationale: Three attempts (rw connect, read_only=True, ATTACH ... (READ_ONLY)) all hit `Conflicting lock is held in PID 1`. DuckDB takes an OS-level exclusive lock on the writer side. Scope for tasks 11-13 does not shrink.

decisions.decision: Observation: post Phase 08-08 the owner does NOT hold the lock continuously
decisions.rationale: After ReadConn + memoized _read_model_enabled, DuckDB connections are thread-local and short-lived. Read-only admin commands (e.g. mirror-coverage) often slip through `docker exec` while the owner is idle. The `just admin` wrapper still gives clean isolation for write-side work; the original blocker description is correct but less catastrophic than thought.

decisions.decision: Use `--entrypoint python` in `compose run` inside `just admin`
decisions.rationale: Image ENTRYPOINT is `python -m mcp_strava.deploy.entrypoint`. Without override, our admin command got appended as extra args and the entrypoint just started the owner process again (long-running healthy run-container, no admin executed). `--entrypoint python` makes the args run as a normal python invocation.

decisions.decision: Trap on EXIT for container restart in `just admin`
decisions.rationale: Guarantees the owner is restarted even on Ctrl-C or admin failure. Recipe uses shebang form (`#!/usr/bin/env bash`) so the trap survives across recipe lines.
